title: checks.config.json
description: Per-repo configuration for the aide-checks package. The package is never forked per repo; every difference lives here. Every exclusion carries a reason.

include.description: MUST contain docs/** and README.md (spec §4.1): scanners commonly skip documentation paths, and NEXUS-C116 lived exactly there.

exclusion_reasons.description: one entry per exclude pattern. Excluding a path because it is noisy is not a reason.

allow_fields.description: Field names whose assigned value is a domain identifier, not a credential (e.g. idempotency_key, feature_key). Suppresses a finding only when gitleaks matched that field, NOT the path: the file stays fully scanned, so a real secret elsewhere in it — or on the same line — still fails. This exists because spec §3 forbids excluding a path for noise, and a committed evidence dump is exactly where a real leak also lands. Every entry requires a matching allow_fields_reasons entry or the check exits 2.

allow_fields_reasons.description: One recorded reason per allow_fields entry. Required: the check refuses to run (exit 2) on an entry with no reason. An allowlist nobody has to justify grows until the scanner means nothing.

patterns.description: This repo's own worktree convention, read from its .gitignore history — not assumed (spec §4.2). An empty list cannot fail and is rejected by the check.

patterns_source.description: where the convention was read from
